chunks: From him, from Ṣafwān and Faḍālah, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two عليهما السلام, who said:

I asked him about a woman being alongside a man in the howdah while they both perform salat together. He said: No; rather, the man should perform salat, and when he has finished, the woman should perform salat.

key_terms.الرَّجُلَ: the man alongside whom she is present
key_terms.الْمَحْمِلِ: the howdah or riding litter in which they are situated
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being referred to in the legal ruling
key_terms.فَرَغَ: he completed or finished the salat

ai.seo_question: Can a man and a woman perform salat at the same time while sitting together in a howdah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about a man and woman praying in close proximity within a howdah. It states that they should not perform salat simultaneously in that setting; instead, the man prays first, and after he finishes, the woman performs salat.
